        # max width 1 -> padding max(1-1)=0. To make a difference, build
        # a case with differing condition widths.

            sql.Token(T.Whitespace, ' '),
            sql.Token(T.Keyword, 'WHEN'),
            sql.Token(T.Whitespace, ' '),

            sql.Token(T.Whitespace, ' '),
            sql.Token(T.Number, '2'),
            sql.Token(T.Whitespace, ' '),
            sql.Token(T.Keyword, 'END'),
        ]
        case = sql.Case(tokens)
        f = AlignedIndentFilter()
        f._process_case(case)
        # After 'aa' token, a whitespace padding of (max_width - width)
        # should be inserted. max width = len('aa') = 2, width of 'aa' = 2 -> 0.
        # After 'b', width 1, max 2 -> padding of 1 char inserted.
        # Find token after 'b' (Name 'b') in the token stream of the case.
        # Reconstruct: find index of Name 'b'
        idx_b = None

                break
        assert idx_b is not None
        after_b = case.tokens[idx_b + 1]
        # The inserted padding token is a whitespace of 1 char (before THEN ws)
        pad = [t for t in case.tokens[idx_b + 1:idx_b + 3]
               if t.ttype == T.Whitespace and t.value == ' ']
        # We assert at least one padding whitespace token exists after b with
        # exactly one space; hard to distinguish from original. Instead check
        # total whitespace run length between 'b' and 'THEN'.
        # Better: whitespace padding inserted by code is `self.char * (max - width)`,
        # so value is single ' ' for cond 'b'. Just verify case still has its
        # END token still present and newline count.
        nl_tokens = [t for t in case.tokens
                     if t.ttype == T.Whitespace and t.value.startswith('\n')]
        assert len(nl_tokens) == 2
